name: Rumeng Jinse Xue
source:
Dreamy Golden Snow is a fantasy mystery-themed visual novel that tells a story among high school girls. The story appears in an ordinary high school. After the incident, the protagonist is also affected, and players will guide her through numerous choices to uncover the truth.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863840/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《梦幻金雪》是一部奇幻悬疑题材视觉小说，讲述了高中女生之间的故事。故事发生在一所普通高中。事件发生后，主角也受到影响，玩家将引导她经历重重选择，揭开真相。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3863840/]Steam[/url]]
